title: Chapter 590 - 590 Arriving At The Lakeside Again; Frozen
content:
Chapter 590 - 590 Arriving At The Lakeside Again; Frozen

Chapter 590 - 590 Arriving at the Lakeside Again; Frozen

590 Arriving at the Lakeside Again; Frozen

Nashland had more than ten people who were selected.

Phillus was one of them.

He was a retired soldier with good physical fitness and shooting ability.

After entering the other world, many of the chosen ones relied on compressed biscuits and licorice to survive. In just a few days, most of them had become sallow and emaciated. They were in a very sorry state.

However, Phillus relied on his survival skills in the wild, his good physical fitness, and his excellent shooting ability to hunt big rabbits.

Although he was not as satisfied as Lin Fan… At least he could ensure that there was meat to eat every day and he would not be too miserable.

After a night’s rest, Phillus carried his luggage and guns. He maintained his vigilance and kept moving forward.

After entering the Otherworld, he once encountered a huge gorilla. It had taken him a lot of effort to successfully escape.

This made Phillus understand that the Otherworld was not safe.

Therefore, he was very careful at every minute.

At this moment, a lake appeared in the distance.

It was clear and spacious.

Phillus could not help but swallow his saliva.

The rabbits in the Otherworld were slightly larger than those on Earth.

However, even though Phillus tried his best to eat sparingly every day, he had already run out of rabbits to hunt.

In addition, the drinking water he carried with him was almost exhausted.

The lake in front of him was a huge supply station for him.

In fact, if he settled down on the lake…

He felt that he could live on forever.

First of all, he did not have to worry about drinking water.

In addition, there would definitely be fish in such a large lake. This was an inexhaustible source of food!

Phillus first looked around. After making sure that there was no danger, he held the handle of the gun and slowly approached the lake.

However, when he was about ten meters away from the lake, Phillus suddenly stopped.

He suddenly remembered that he was the Otherworld. In the unknown depths of the water, there was a high possibility of danger.

Thus, Phillus slowly retreated.

However, it was also at this time…

A huge tentacle as thick as a tree trunk suddenly stretched out from the calm bottom of the lake and shot toward Phillus.

Phillus’ heart thumped wildly, and he quickly pulled the trigger.

Blood splattered on the surface of the tentacle, but it did not stop moving forward.

In the end, the tentacle wrapped around Phillus and dragged him into the lake. No matter how Phillus slapped, struggled, or fired, it was useless.

After a few bubbles appeared on the surface of the lake, everything returned to calm.

Immediately after, an emotionless voice sounded in the ears of the Nashland people.

[Phillus, the chosen one, has died. The air quality in Nashland has dropped by 20%.]

…

In Nashland’s live broadcast room.

K: [Oh my god! What kind of monster is that?]

Hong: [Phillus is dead.]

YY: [The air is getting murky!]

Mike: [The Otherworld is too dangerous.]

WW: [So scary!]

…

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

Cockroach: [Watching GOd Lin’s live broadcast, I feel that the Otherworld is very interesting.]

I’m Afraid of Ghosts: [Yeah, there’s so much delicious food and such beautiful scenery.]

Chaos: [If I drive an RV there, I think I can play there for a year!]

Those Years: [Don’t think that the Otherworld is so beautiful. The retired American soldier just died.]

Little Light: [I saw it too. It was so strange.]

Cyan: [F*ck! The location that God Lin is heading to seems to be the place where the retired American soldier just walked past!]

Little Bridge Running Water: [That’s true. God Lin, you’d better not go any farther.]

Man in the Wind: [God Lin went to the lake once and met a giant crocodile. He probably won’t go again this time, right?]

…

Lin Fan did not see everyone’s reminders at all. He walked forward unhurriedly.

After passing through a patch of withered grass, a lake appeared in front of him.

Silence!

Deadly silence!

The Heavenly Hound sniffed. As if it had sensed something, its eyes became stern.

However, Lin Fan did not stop there. He continued walking forward, getting closer and closer to the surface of the lake.

100 meters.

90 meters.

80 meters.

…

Lin Fan kept taking steps forward. Every step he took felt like he was stepping on the hearts of the live audience.

When he was only ten meters away from the lake…

A thick tentacle suddenly jumped out from the bottom of the lake. Its target… was Lin Fan and the Heavenly Hound!

The Heavenly Hound barked.

Its body instantly became three meters tall. At the same time, it extended its sharp claws that were like steel knives and slapped fiercely.

The thick tentacle was like a sausage, directly cutting into several pieces as fresh blood splattered everywhere.

Suddenly, a roar sounded from the lake.

Then, a dozen thick tentacles shot toward Lin Fan and the Heavenly Hound.

The Heavenly Hound either waved its claws or bit down, trying its best to resist. It snapped the tentacles to the ground.

The roars of the monster in the lake became even more ear-piercing.

At the same time, the surface of the vast lake churned violently. The water level rose continuously, forming a tsunami that was more than a hundred meters tall, like a towering wall of water.

There was a roar.

The tsunami swept out with terrifying power and slammed toward the Heavenly Hound and Lin Fan.

Seeing this…

The Heavenly Hound’s pupils contracted slightly.

Even the Heavenly Hound felt a trace of fear from such a terrifying tsunami.

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

Xiao Bing shouted, “God Lin, run!”

My People: [Hurry up and leave!]

Tiny Teenager: [Run!]

Boxer: [Run! It’s dangerous!]

…

Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Qin Yuxuan, and the others clenched their fists tightly and prayed in their hearts, ‘Lin Fan, you have to be safe!’

…

Perhaps the crowd’s call had worked.

Lin Fan, who had not moved at all, finally opened his eyes.

Just as the terrifying tsunami was about to hit him, Lin Fan opened his mouth and spat out a word, “Freeze!”

A gust of cold air spread rapidly.

The tsunami that was about to strike down instantly solidified and froze!

No!

Not only did the tsunami freeze, but the entire lake had also turned into a thick layer of ice!

Inside the ice, one could vaguely see a huge octopus monster and many small fish… None of them could move.

At this moment, it was as if space itself had been frozen. It was extremely strange.

Lin Fan pulled out the Star Meteorite Sword from his waist and waved it out casually.

[Skill: Sword 2!]

In the next moment, the octopus monster trapped in the ice layer was directly cut into countless pieces.

The thick tentacles that were originally wrapped around the Heavenly Hound also fell to the ground.

At the same time, an emotionless voice rang out in Lin Fan’s ears.

[The first to kill a level-five Abyssal Octopus. You’ve obtained a level-five treasure chest.]

[The first to kill a level-five Abyssal Octopus. Hua Nation’s mines have increased by 20%.]
